title: CGBSE Time Table 2027 to be released soon: Check expected CG Board 10th, 12th exam dates

 News › Exams News › CGBSE Time Table 2027 to be released soon: Check expected CG Board 10th, 12th exam dates CGBSE Time Table 2027 to be released soon: Check expected CG Board 10th, 12th exam dates
 Jasleen Taneja Updated: Oct 27, 2026, 00:38 IST CG Board time table 2027 Out Soon CGBSE Time Table 2027 : The Chhattisgarh Board of Secondary Education (CGBSE) is expected to release the CGBSE exam dates 2027 for classes 10, 12 soon. The CGBSE Date Sheet 2027 will be published on the official website, cgbse.nic.in. It is expected that the CG Board time tabl2 2027 will be out in November 2026. 
 Theory exams for both classes are likely to begin in February 2027 and continue till March 2027. Practical exams may take place in January 2027.
 CGBSE Time Table 2027: Expected Dates
 The table below lists the expected schedule for the CG Board exams 2027.
 Particulars 10th Class 12th Class 
 Board Name Chhattisgarh Board of Secondary Education (CGBSE) Chhattisgarh Board of Secondary Education (CGBSE) 
 Time Table Release Dates November 2026 (Expected) November 2026 (Expected) 
 Practical Exams January 2027 (Expected) January 2027 (Expected) 
 Theory Exams February to March 2027 (Expected) February to March 2027 (Expected) 
 Official Website http://cgbse.nic.in http://cgbse.nic.in 
 CG Board 10th, 12th Date Sheet 2027: Details mentioned
 Students will find these details on the date sheet:
 Exam date and day
 Subject name
 Subject code
 Exam timing
 Instructions for the exam day
 Steps to download CGBSE Time Table 2027 PDF
 Once the timetable is released, students can get the PDF in a few simple steps.
 Visit the official website, cgbse.nic.in.
 Find the 2027 time table link on the homepage.
 Pick the date sheet for 10th Class or 12th Class.
 Check the dates for your subjects once the PDF opens.
 Save a copy to plan your revision.
 Till the official date sheets are released, students can refer to the tentative CG Board time table 2027 for Classes 10 and 12 shared below.
